items.heading: For Each Option, Collect Four
items.text: For each option, collect four things: ten live notices (what the role asks for), three conversations with people in the role (what the work is like), one small task done yourself (how it feels) and the total cost and time to reach a first paid role.

items.heading: Some Pairs Fit Together, Such
items.text: Some pairs fit together, such as design plus code, finance plus data, or teaching plus content. The mix can be harder to replace than either alone.

rows: Decide by comparing in your head
You are guessing how the work feels and what it pays.
Decide with a four-week test of each option
You see the work, the proof needed and the response from people in the field.
Decide by asking only family or friends
They know you, but may not know the field.
Decide by picking the option with the lowest regret if wrong
It protects money, time and options when evidence is close.
